title: VANTABLACK
body: Roll call. VANTABLACK again — or is it VANTABLUE tonight? The letters on the sheet have been written over. The radio is waiting.

outcome.text: "Copy." He does not say all clear. He does not say anything else.

choices.label: Use the name on the sheet, whatever it is.

outcome.text: You say it. He laughs, once, like a man who has heard his own eulogy. "Again, Operator?"
